text: Hey, welcome to Upon Further Review brought to you by Cororsite. I'm your host Paul Guettes and a lot of news to report on and talk about in this episode. Let's start with the calendar. And I think when you look at Kirk's body of work, everywhere he has been, um, he has been a pretty consistent player really week in and week out. I think you're talking about a guy that has 167 career starts. He's thrown for almost 45,000 yards and almost 300 touchdowns. So, uh, you know, you love that about him. Uh, I think and even more importantly, I think it's a type of person that Kurt Cousins is. He's he's a person with great character, integrity, toughness. I always say when I evaluate the quarterback position, two non-negotiables for me, physical, mental toughness. This guy has it. He doesn't miss a lot of starts. Uh, I I think he makes players around him better. Uh, and I think he's going to be a real asset uh to Fernando Mendoza because I think, you know, that's going to be really important when you start to build a football team. That quarterback room is is really the uh, you know, the lifeblood of of your organization. And I think having the right people in that room is is so important. >> Yeah. They al they they they crossed paths though back in Minnesota, one of your former stomping grounds as well and Andrew Janoko coached him in Minnesota. How how clutch is that to have that already that familiarity?
